- Token mix (hosted trial telemetry): ~72% requests <150 tokens, ~22% 150–800 tokens, ~6% >800 tokens.

- Latency targets: p50 <200ms for search model (embedding retrieval + 1-chunk rerank), p95 <500ms for chat.

Dedicated sizing & traffic forecast (recommended in POC doc): 
- Target steady-state QPS to size for: 60 qps (2x current avg) to allow growth, with headroom for 250 qps bursts.
- Concurrency target: provision for sustained 60 concurrent model streams with ability to burst to 220 concurrent streams.
- Token throughput: plan for sustained 4M tokens/minute (roughly matches expected product growth to 3x trial volume in 6–9 months).
- GPU pool recommendation: 4 x A100-class nodes (or 6 x H100-similar with mixed batching) with autoscaling policy: +2 nodes at 70% token throughput, +4 nodes at 90%.
- Caching/batching plan: enable prefix KV caching for chat sessions (expected 18% token savings), 50ms batching window for low-latency search paths to increase throughput without breaching p95 targets.

- Customer requesting committed monthly capacity quote (reserved) vs burstable billing. Prefers predictable unit economics for renewals.
- Proposed ARR bands in pricing deck attached: $120k (min) / $200k / $300k tiers depending on ded. capacity and retention SLA.
